from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which of the OTHER provided papers it references in its bibliography."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as found in the document")
    referenced_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the collection that this paper explicitly cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
